text: A church was rebuilt at Mosfell in the 1960s. It was built for posterity by Stefán Þorlákssonar (1895-1959), a district administrative officer in Reykjadalur in the Mosfell Valley. Stefán grew up at Hrísbrú and knew well the old church at Mosfell that had once existed. The Mosfell church was established as a non-profit organization and the income was interestingly gained by selling warm water, the rights to which Stefán had donated to the church in his will.
